title: lp2033565-stonking → ubuntu/stonking-devel
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index ec6121c..1bbd2c8 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+qemu-hwe (1:10.2.1+ds-1ubuntu8) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/rules, d/qemu-kvm-init: remove KSM handling from init script
+    (LP: #2033565)
+
+ -- Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>  Wed, 24 Jun 2026 10:31:41 +0200
+
 qemu-hwe (1:10.2.1+ds-1ubuntu7) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   * d/hwe-helper/99-ubuntu-virt.conf: invoke apt hook only if script exists
diff --git a/debian/qemu-kvm-init b/debian/qemu-kvm-init
index af00b71..c88562c 100755
--- a/debian/qemu-kvm-init
+++ b/debian/qemu-kvm-init
@@ -52,27 +52,6 @@ start() {
         chown root:kvm /dev/kvm || true
         chmod g+rw /dev/kvm || true
     fi
-
-    # Determine if we are running inside a VM
-    IS_VM=0
-    if command -v systemd-detect-virt >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-        systemd-detect-virt -vq && IS_VM=1
-    fi
-
-    # Enable KSM, respecting the default configuration file. If 'AUTO' is
-    # set, enable only if we aren't running inside a VM.
-    if [ "$KSM_ENABLED" = "1" ] || [ "$KSM_ENABLED" = "AUTO" ] && [ "$IS_VM" = "0" ]; then
-        # shellcheck disable=SC2015
-        [ -w /sys/kernel/mm/ksm/run ] && echo 1 > /sys/kernel/mm/ksm/run || true
-        if [ -w /sys/kernel/mm/ksm/sleep_millisecs ]; then
-            if [ -n "$SLEEP_MILLISECS" ]; then
-                echo "$SLEEP_MILLISECS" > /sys/kernel/mm/ksm/sleep_millisecs || true
-            fi
-        fi
-    else
-        # shellcheck disable=SC2015
-        [ -w /sys/kernel/mm/ksm/run ] && echo 0 > /sys/kernel/mm/ksm/run || true
-    fi
 }
 
 # See how we were called.
diff --git a/debian/qemu-system-common-hwe.qemu-kvm.default b/debian/qemu-system-common-hwe.qemu-kvm.default
deleted file mode 100644
index 08ab26c..0000000
--- a/debian/qemu-system-common-hwe.qemu-kvm.default
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,8 +0,0 @@
-# Set to 1 to enable KSM, 0 to disable KSM, and AUTO to use default settings.
-# After changing this setting restart the qemu-kvm service.
-KSM_ENABLED=AUTO
-SLEEP_MILLISECS=200
-
-# Dropped VHOST_NET_ENABLED as this is auto-loaded in recent kernels
-
-# Dropped KVM_HUGEPAGES as systemd provides feasible hugepage moutpoints
diff --git a/debian/qemu-system-common.maintscript b/debian/qemu-system-common.maintscript
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..24b062b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/qemu-system-common.maintscript
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+rm_conffile /etc/default/qemu-kvm 1:10.2.1+ds-1ubuntu8~
\ No newline at end of file
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index da9d4f2..3612f6b 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -467,8 +467,6 @@ install-arch: pre-install-arch $(addprefix install-, ${qemu-builds})
 	dh_installman -a
 	dh_link -a
 	dh_installinit -pqemu-guest-agent-hwe --name=qemu-guest-agent
-	# install /etc/default/qemu-kvm
-	dh_installinit -a -pqemu-system-common-hwe --name=qemu-kvm
 	dh_installsystemd -pqemu-guest-agent-hwe --name=qemu-guest-agent --no-enable
 	dh_installudev -pqemu-guest-agent-hwe --name=qemu-guest-agent
 	# install and enable qemu-kvm.service
